camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListHostGroupsForUser --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --PageNumber '１' --UserId '１' --Mode Authorized --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostGroupName group
description_en: Queries a list of host groups that a bastion host user is authorized or is not authorized to manage
description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机用户已授权或未授权的主机组列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-groups-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode Authorized --user-id '１' --page-number '１' --page-size 20 --host-group-name group --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostGroupsForUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose user you want to query.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose user you want to query.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The category of the host groups to query. Valid values:

- **Authorized** (default): queries the host groups that the user is authorized to manage.

- **Unauthorized**: queries the host groups that the user is not authorized to manage
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机组列表的模式。取值：
- **Authorized**：已授权（默认）
- **Unauthorized**：未授权
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The user ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the user ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. > We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host group to query. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机组名称。最多支持128字符，仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_group_name
